name: The loaded flank
engine: Load the right flank so cut-backs reach Olmo unmarked, where he needs only 2 for a clean win.
about: Porro and Yamal load the right. A clean pass to anyone on the right leaves him unmarked (Overload one flank); Porro's overlap does not use up a decision and leaves a gap when it comes off (Overlaps); when either of the two wins a duel cleanly there is space on the right (Flank partners), and that space lasts the whole attack (Loaded flank). Every cut-back and low cross goes to Olmo, not Oyarzabal (Nominated receiver), and when Olmo shoots unmarked a clean win needs only 2 (Cool head). The price: Baena, alone on the left, is -1 in every duel.
decisions: Where to go: attacks are pulled to the right, where passes leave men unmarked, and away from Baena on the left.
Porro's overlap is a free extra step before the cross or the cut-back.
Olmo, a weaker finisher than Oyarzabal, is the man the ball goes to, because he arrives unmarked and Cool head turns that into goals.
